function.arguments: {"reflection":"Plan: commission one focused research pass to assemble a source-grounded reconstruction of the Internet Research Agency’s 2016 United States social-media influence operation. The researcher should prioritize primary materials (Department of Justice indictments, Senate Intelligence Committee findings, platform disclosures/data, and official investigative records), preserve the exact source IDs returned by the benchmark, and explicitly separate established facts, allegations, analytical assessments, and uncertainty. It should map entities, personas/accounts, funding and organizational relationships, operational activities, objectives, contradictions, and source provenance without inventing identifiers or unsupported links. After reviewing the result, I will assess whether a second targeted pass is needed for gaps or contradictions."}
function.name: think_tool
